svg.text: Bearing cap lubrication | handbook illustration and native candidate
HB20 Plate11: low oil fitting and wool-filled cup. Native: closed cap and source-listed fitting set. Views are not registered.
SNL56 identifies the three cap fittings; SNL261/262 specifies quarter-inch outside diameter for their feed tubes.
Remaining differences: rounded cup/cast transitions and upper opening. Inlet face and fitting geometry are inferred.
Full armored lines and lubricator are pending. Wool is a porous envelope; threads, seals and oil performance are unqualified.
